```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)

# Paths to CSVs (adjust if needed)

md_csv = "metadata_enriched.csv"

metadata <- fread(md_csv)
metadata <- metadata[ IS_VALID ==T]
ggplot(metadata, aes(ROI_SIZE_MM , DRYMASS_MG^(1/3),shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + geom_point(alpha=.3)  + facet_grid(DATASET ~ .) 

ggplot(metadata, aes(BF_cbrMG_MM,shape=DATASET, fill=DATASET)) + geom_histogram()+ facet_grid(DATASET ~ )


```
